nina (pm): Quick sync: Sales flagged a request to ship a "lite" entry path for the Orchid family (orchid-lite, 4-bit quant) with a migration/retirement plan for orchid-v1. Need to nail acceptance and rollback criteria before committing to roadmap.

emma (sales-corp): Customer X is asking for a lower-cost pin option ASAP. They can accept slightly lower embedding fidelity if we provide a firm deprecation window for orchid-v1.

rafael (eng-runtime): Runtime concerns: 4-bit will affect KV cache behavior and may increase tail latency due to dequant steps. We need bench targets + a staged rollout.

priya (eng-ml): From quality POV, target: embedding cosine median < 2.0% vs orchid-v1 FP16; 95th < 4.0%. For generation, perplexity delta < 1.8% on our doc-summarization slice.

kyle (solutions): Propose three gates: (1) Bench pass on Dedicated medium, (2) Shadow traffic for 72h across 3 tenants, (3) 10% canary for 48h with rollback hooks.

nina (pm): Let's codify acceptance criteria and migration commitments.
- Bench: p50 < 90ms; p95 < 320ms on Dedicated medium; no OOMs in 1M token sim run.
- Quality: embed_median_cosine_diff < 2.0%; embed_95 < 4.0%; gen_perplexity_delta < 1.8%
- Regression: downstream search MRR drop <= 0.7% relative vs FP16 baseline
- Ops: auto-fallback on p95 +30% for 10m or error rate >0.25% for 15m

rafael (eng-runtime): Add runtime compatibility checks: identical tokenization outputs for 99.9% requests; kv-cache hit rate within 2% of baseline when using warm sessions. Also add disk footprint < 40% reduction requirement? (we expect quant to save memory, but ensure it doesn't blow other caches).

priya (eng-ml): Also require model logits drift check for top-k (top1/top3) parity: top1 mismatch < 2% and top3 mismatch < 5% on the stability slice. If exceeded, require an A/B run.

kyle (solutions): For migration we need clear customer options: (A) Pin to orchid-v1 for 6 months (paid extension), (B) soft pin with auto-fallback if regressions, (C) opt-into orchid-lite now with visibility into drift metrics.

emma (sales-corp): Sales prefers option C + migration credits for first 3 months. Legal wants a 90-day notice for any hard deprecation. Can product doc that?

nina (pm): Yes, add deprecation policy: 90 days notice for pinned models, 180 days for unpinned. For orchard of orchid-v1 specifically, propose 6-month pinned grace path for enterprise customers who sign the opt-in SOW.

rafael (eng-runtime): Operational runbook items: trace tags for rollout, cold/warm run counters, an automated bench job and a rollback playbook. I'll draft the auto-fallback implementation: look for rolling p95 increase and embedding drift alerts.

priya (eng-ml): Bench harness spec: 5 seeds, slices = {doc-summarize, qna-short, embed-stability}, each pass = 50k tokens; measure embed histograms and top-k mismatch. Script example:
```
./run_bench --model=orchid-lite --slices=embed-stability,doc-summarize --runs=5 --pin=dedicated-medium
```
Store artifacts and deterministic seed metadata.

kyle (solutions): Reporting: one-page customer acceptance template (bench results, drift charts, rollback triggers, timeline). I'll own the template.

emma (sales-corp): Timeline ask from Sales: earliest GA in 6 weeks. Is that feasible?

nina (pm): Rough timeline: Week 0: acceptance doc finalization & customer opt-in; Week 1: bench infra + runtime hooks; Week 2: bench runs + fixes; Week 3: shadow + 72h observation; Week 4: canary 10% 48h; Week 5: extended canary / enterprise opt-ins; Week 6: GA contingent on no critical regressions. So 6 weeks seems tight but possible if no surprises.

rafael (eng-runtime): Risks: tokenization drift, increased p95 tails under burst. Contingency: if bench shows p95 violations > 15% we halt rollout and open incident.

priya (eng-ml): Also watch for reranker downstream surprises — add a gated A/B (50/50) for any tenant where reranker drop >0.5% during shadow.

opsbot: runbook-ticket created #RB-2481 linking bench job and canary workflow at 1720012500.

kyle (solutions): Action list:
- Nina: publish acceptance doc + deprecation windows (ETA: EOD)
- Rafael: implement trace tags + auto-fallback stubs (ETA: 3d)
- Priya: bench harness + initial run (ETA: 4d)
- Emma: coordinate customer opt-in & SOW language (ETA: 5d)
- Opsbot: wire canary automation and pager hooks

nina (pm): OK, I'll update the roadmap ticket and add owners. If no objections, we'll lock this as a candidate for next sprint's kickoff. Short comments only please.

emma (sales-corp): No objections from Sales.

rafael (eng-runtime): 👍 will start PR for fallback logic.

priya (eng-ml): Starting bench now, will share artifacts when ready.

nina (pm): Closing thread — will drop doc link once live.
